analysis.full_description: A flat-lay product photograph styled for Valentine's Day. The pink Steamline Pro (Steambrush Pro) hair straightener brush rests vertically in the center on a blush pink background. It is framed by deep red roses, scattered soft pink and red rose petals, metallic gold heart cutouts, and tiny golden foil confetti pieces. Prominent white serif and sans-serif typography at the top announces 'VALENTINE'S SALE IS ON! GET 20% OFF YOUR STEAMLINE PRO. Look your best this V-Day. Limited time offer!'.

on_screen_text.text: Look your best this V-Day. Limited time offer!
